scenario: Family-level error matching per LECC.6.2 — `error adapter:` catches every leaf an adapter reports under `adapter` ([LECC.4.3]). An `error adapter:` continuation, naming a family rather than a leaf, compiles. PINS ONLY THAT IT COMPILES: `compile_ok` observes neither the sibling rule's `adapter.*` prefix match (LCCO.8.3) nor which codes it catches.
rules_ds:
service weather.get_forecasts:
    kwarg entity_id: String
    no response

schema TimeOfDay scope ttl 1_min:
    state: String

rule daily_forecast:
    TimeOfDay t where t.state == "18:00"
->
    call weather.get_forecasts entity_id: "weather.home" cooldown: 23_h
        error adapter:
            log info "adapter problem"
